授業概要
This term, I will be using my Thursday evening postgraduate seminar class mainly as a 'workshop' to share and discuss with students draft chapter of my forthcoming book analysing changing official narratives of 'frontier histories' in China - relating to Tibet, Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Focusing on changes during the early 21st century, the book primarily examines historical museums and school textbooks in an attempt to understand how China's claims to these frontier regions have been explained or justified to the Chinese public (especially students), and how and why the basis for those justifications has shifted, especially under Xi Jinping.
